INSERT INTO seller_profile_research_runs (
                profile_id,
                organization_id,
                workflow_run_id,
                trigger,
                status,
                requested_by_user_id,
                requested_at,
                started_at,
                finished_at,
                metadata,
                created_at,
                updated_at
            )
            SELECT
                $1,
                $2,
                NULL,
                'seed-run-' || gs::text,
                'SUCCEEDED'::seller_profile_research_run_status,
                $3,
                now() - make_interval(hours => gs::int),
                now() - make_interval(hours => gs::int),
                now() - make_interval(hours => gs::int),
                jsonb_build_object('seed', gs),
                now() - make_interval(hours => gs::int),
                now() - make_interval(hours => gs::int)
            FROM generate_series(1, 110) gs
